summary: Surf Air Mobility Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement covering a registered direct offering of 13,575,534 shares of common stock at $1.10 per share (institutional investors) and $1.36 per share (directors/officers), raising $15.0M. This is a routine at-the-market/registered direct equity offering, not a special situation. The filing discloses use of proceeds, dilution, and risk factors. No tender offer, going-private, restructuring, or other special-situation event is present. No deal terms beyond price/shares.
